newsitem.title: USA: Tribune Co buys $2 mln stake in Mercury Mail.
newsitem.headline: Tribune Co buys $2 mln stake in Mercury Mail.

text.p: Tribune Co said on Wednesday it paid $2 million for a minority equity position in Mercury Mail Inc to provide information to customers via e-mail technology.
Tribune Media Services, Tribune Publishing's syndication arm, and Mercury Mail will develop, market and cross-promote information that Mercury would deliver, Tribune Co said.
Denver-based Mercury Mail delivers news, weather, stocks, sports and entertainment information based on a subscriber's personal preference, at no cost to the consumer.
Mercury, formed in early 1995, generates revenues by selling advertising within e-mail messages sent to subscribers and delivering customized e-mail information for third parties for a fee.
Tribune Co, an information and entertainment company, also is an equity investor in other emerging-media businesses.
